examples.chinese: 今天天氣好熱。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hǎo rè.
examples.english: The weather is so hot today.

examples.chinese: 天氣太熱，我要喝飲料。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì tài rè, wǒ yào hē yǐnliào.
examples.english: The weather is too hot, I want some beverage.

examples.chinese: 天氣好熱，我們去喝飲料，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì hǎo rè, wǒmen qù hē yǐnliào, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: The weather is so hot. How about we go have some drink?

examples.chinese: 秋天的天氣最好，不冷也不熱。
examples.pinyin: Qiūtiān de tiānqì zuì hǎo, bù lěng yě bú rè.
examples.english: The weather is the best in autumn, not too cold and not too hot.

examples.chinese: 台灣夏天的天氣很熱，很多人都喜歡喝飲料。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān xiàtiān de tiānqì hěn rè, hěn duō rén dōu xǐhuān hē yǐnliào.
examples.english: During summer the weather is very hot in Taiwan, many people like to have beverages.

examples.chinese: 天氣好熱，我們去游泳，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì hǎo rè, wǒmen qù yóuyǒng, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: The weather is so hot. How about we go swimming?

examples.chinese: 我去年去看了，很多大人帶著小孩去看燈會，非常熱鬧，我照了很多相片。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qùnián qù kàn le, hěn duō dàrén dài zhe xiǎohái qù kàn dēnghuì, fēicháng rènào, wǒ zhào le hěn duō xiàngpiàn.
examples.english: Last year I went to see the Carnival. Many adults brought their children to see the Lantern Carnival, and it was very lively. I took a lot of photos.

items.wordHook: an 埶(art) rests deep in the warm 灬(fire) → glowing 熱(hot).

examples.chinese: 去年台灣冬天的溫度很低，只有五度，冷死了。
examples.pinyin: Qùnián Táiwān dōngtiān de wēndù hěn dī, zhǐyǒu wǔ dù, lěng sǐ le.
examples.english: Last year, the temperature in Taiwan in winter was very low—only five degrees—it was freezing!

examples.chinese: 去年台灣冬天的溫度很低，差不多五度，冷得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Qùnián Táiwān dōngtiān de wēndù hěn dī, chàbuduō wǔ dù, lěng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: Last year, the temperature in Taiwan in winter was very low, about five degrees, and it was extremely cold.

examples.chinese: 對我來說，冬天的樂趣就是戴著厚厚的手套，和朋友玩雪球。
examples.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, dōngtiān de lèqù jiùshì dài zhe hòu hòu de shǒutào, hé péngyǒu wán xuěqiú.
examples.english: For me, the joy of winter is wearing thick gloves and playing snowballs with friends.

examples.chinese: 冬天一到，我的皮膚就變得很乾，所以得注意保養。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān yí dào, wǒ de pífū jiù biàn de hěn gān, suǒyǐ děi zhùyì bǎoyǎng.
examples.english: As soon as winter arrives, my skin becomes very dry, so I have to pay attention to skincare.

examples.chinese: 每年冬天快到時，舅舅和舅媽就開始計畫去滑雪，有時還約我跟媽媽一起去。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián dōngtiān kuài dào shí, jiùjiu hé jiùmā jiù kāishǐ jìhuà qù huáxuě, yǒushí hái yuē wǒ gēn māma yīqǐ qù.
examples.english: Every year when winter is approaching, my uncle and aunt start planning to go skiing, and sometimes they even invite me and my mom to go together.

examples.chinese: 母親為家人親手織了幾件毛衣，希望讓大家過個溫暖的冬天。
examples.pinyin: Mǔqīn wèi jiārén qīnshǒu zhī le jǐ jiàn máoyī, xīwàng ràng dàjiā guò ge wēnnuǎn de dōngtiān.
examples.english: Mother personally knitted several sweaters for the family, hoping to let everyone have a warm winter.

examples.chinese: 冰店的生意好壞得看季節，冬天的生意總是不如夏天。
examples.pinyin: Bīngdiàn de shēngyì hǎohuài děi kàn jìjié, dōngtiān de shēngyì zǒngshì bùrú xiàtiān.
examples.english: Whether a shaved ice shop's business is good or bad depends on the season; business in winter is always not as good as in summer.

examples.chinese: A:聽說百貨公司的衣服要降價了，現在降了嗎？ B:夏天的衣服降價了，因為已經開始賣冬天的衣服了。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō bǎihuò gōngsī de yīfu yào jiàngjià le, xiànzài jiàng le ma? B: Xiàtiān de yīfu jiàngjià le, yīnwèi yǐjīng kāishǐ mài dōngtiān de yīfu le.
examples.english: A: I heard that the department store's clothes are going to drop in price; have they dropped now? B: Summer clothes have dropped in price, because they've already started selling winter clothes.

examples.chinese: 在冬天，臺灣南部比北部暖和，你可以到南部享受暖暖的陽光。
examples.pinyin: Zài dōngtiān, Táiwān nánbù bǐ běibù nuǎnhuo, nǐ kěyǐ dào nánbù xiǎngshòu nuǎnnuǎn de yángguāng.
examples.english: In winter, southern Taiwan is warmer than the north; you can go to the south to enjoy the warm sunshine.

examples.chinese: 以往在冬天才開的花，沒想到夏天就開了，大家都覺得很意外。
examples.pinyin: Yǐwǎng zài dōngtiān cái kāi de huā, méi xiǎngdào xiàtiān jiù kāi le, dàjiā dōu juéde hěn yìwài.
examples.english: Flowers that used to bloom only in winter unexpectedly bloomed in summer; everyone felt very surprised.

examples.chinese: 在冬天的深夜裡，坐在溫暖的地毯上靜靜地看書是一種享受。
examples.pinyin: Zài dōngtiān de shēnyè lǐ, zuò zài wēnnuǎn de dìtǎn shàng jìngjìng de kànshū shì yī zhǒng xiǎngshòu.
examples.english: In the late night of winter, sitting on a warm carpet and reading quietly is a kind of enjoyment.

items.wordHook: 冬(winter) + 天(day) → winter days, so 冬天 means winter.

examples.chinese: 我們要怎麼去？坐捷運還是坐公車？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zěnme qù? Zuò jiéyùn háishì zuò gōngchē?
examples.english: How do we get there? By MRT or bus?

items.wordHook: 公(public) + 共(common) + 汽(steam) + 車(vehicle) → a public vehicle for everyone: 公共汽車(bus).

examples.chinese: 別的時間可以嗎？
examples.pinyin: Biéde shíjiān kěyǐ ma?
examples.english: Can you swap the time?

examples.chinese: 我朋友最近比較忙，別的時間他沒有空。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ péngyǒu zuìjìn bǐjiào máng, biéde shíjiān tā méi yǒukòng.
examples.english: My friend is busier lately; he isn’t available at other times.

examples.chinese: 我記得有羊、馬、兔子……，最特別的是龍。（打開課本）妳看看……
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìdé yǒu yáng, mǎ, tùzi..., zuì tèbié de shì lóng. (dǎkāi kèběn) Nǐ kànkan...
examples.english: I remember there are goats, horses, rabbits..., and the most special one is the dragon. (Open the textbook) You see...

items.wordHook: 別(other) + 的(possessive) → some other one: 別的(other; else).

examples.chinese: 他發燒了？那他應該去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Tā fāshāo le? Nà tā yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: He has a fever? He should see a doctor then.

examples.chinese: 國安跟我說，他今天要去看醫生，他家附近有一家不錯的醫院。
examples.pinyin: Guó'ān gēn wǒ shuō, tā jīntiān yào qù kàn yīshēng, tā jiā fùjìn yǒu yì jiā búcuò de yīyuàn.
examples.english: Guoan told me he is going to see a doctor today; there is a nice hospital near his place.

examples.chinese: 好，謝謝醫生。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo, xièxie yīshēng.
examples.english: Okay, Thank you doctor.

examples.chinese: 他說他會去看醫生，請我們不要擔心，如果他好了，就會來學校上課。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō tā huì qù kàn yīshēng, qǐng wǒmen bú yào dānxīn, rúguǒ tā hǎo le, jiù huì lái xuéxiào shàngkè.
examples.english: He said he will go see a doctor and he does not want to worry us. If he feels better, he will come to school.

examples.chinese: 我很擔心他，請他去看醫生，也告訴他要聽醫生的話，不要忘記多喝水、多休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn dānxīn tā, qǐng tā qù kàn yīshēng, yě gàosu tā yào tīng yīshēng de huà, bú yào wàngjì duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxí.
examples.english: I’m so worried about him, so I told him to go see a doctor. I also told him to listen to the doctor, to drink plenty of water and get some rest.

items.wordHook: 醫(medical) + 生(person suffix) → the medical person: 醫生 is a doctor.

examples.chinese: 在台灣，很多年輕人喜歡當咖啡店的老闆。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, hěn duō niánqīngrén xǐhuān dāng kāfēi diàn de lǎobǎn.
examples.english: In Taiwan, many young people like to be the boss of a coffee shop.

examples.chinese: 他今天上班遲到了，老闆不太高興。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān shàngbān chídào le, lǎobǎn bú tài gāoxìng.
examples.english: He was late for work today; the boss is not too happy.

examples.chinese: 老闆要跟我們談話，想知道我們工作做得怎麼樣。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn yào gēn wǒmen tánhuà, xiǎng zhīdào wǒmen gōngzuò zuò de zěnmeyàng.
examples.english: The boss wants to have a conversation with us; he wants to know how our work is going.

examples.chinese: 聽說這家工廠的工人都很辛苦，可是老闆給的錢不多。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè jiā gōngchǎng de gōngrén dōu hěn xīnkǔ, kěshì lǎobǎn gěi de qián bù duō.
examples.english: I heard that the workers at this factory all work very hard, but the money the boss gives is not much.

examples.chinese: 老闆今天帶我去參觀了一家工廠。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn jīntiān dài wǒ qù cānguān le yì jiā gōngchǎng.
examples.english: The boss took me to visit a factory today.

examples.chinese: 在夜市買東西的時候，有些人會跟老闆殺價。
examples.pinyin: Zài yèshì mǎi dōngxi de shíhou, yǒuxiē rén huì gēn lǎobǎn shājià.
examples.english: When shopping at the night market, some people will bargain with the vendor.

examples.chinese: 媽媽有時候會跟市場的老闆講價，希望價錢能便宜一點兒。
examples.pinyin: Māma yǒu shíhou huì gēn shìchǎng de lǎobǎn jiǎngjià, xīwàng jiàqián néng piányi yìdiǎnr.
examples.english: Mom sometimes bargains with the market vendors, hoping the price can be a little cheaper.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"他常常遲到，讓老闆很生氣。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"弟弟的房間又髒又亂，已經三個月沒打掃了，所以媽媽生他的氣。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Tā chángcháng chídào, ràng lǎobǎn hěn shēngqì. / Dìdi de fángjiān yòu zāng yòu luàn, yǐjīng sān ge yuè méi dǎsǎo le, suǒyǐ māma shēng tā de qì.
examples.english: He is often late, which makes his boss very angry. / Younger brother's room is both dirty and messy; it has been three months since it was cleaned, so mom is angry at him.

examples.chinese: 他一直很努力，所以現在當老闆了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīzhí hěn nǔlì, suǒyǐ xiànzài dāng lǎobǎn le.
examples.english: He has always made efforts, so now he has become a boss.

examples.chinese: 你上班老是遲到，老闆不生氣嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shàngbān lǎoshì chídào, lǎobǎn bù shēngqì ma?
examples.english: You are always late for work; isn't your boss angry?

examples.chinese: 我以為張先生是那家公司的大老闆，其實他只是個小職員。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi Zhāng xiānsheng shì nà jiā gōngsī de dà lǎobǎn, qíshí tā zhǐshì gè xiǎo zhíyuán.
examples.english: I thought Mr. Zhang was the big boss of that company, but actually he is just a small clerk.

examples.chinese: 我是陳老闆的助理，每天得向他報告公司的情況。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì Chén lǎobǎn de zhùlǐ, měitiān děi xiàng tā bàogào gōngsī de qíngkuàng.
examples.english: I am Boss Chen's assistant; every day I have to report the company's situation to him.

examples.chinese: 今天晚上老闆請客，我得穿正式一點兒的服裝。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshang lǎobǎn qǐngkè, wǒ děi chuān zhèngshì yìdiǎnr de fúzhuāng.
examples.english: Tonight the boss is treating us, so I have to wear somewhat formal clothing.

examples.chinese: 陳小姐的工作能力很強，難怪可以當老闆的助理。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiǎojiě de gōngzuò nénglì hěn qiáng, nánguài kěyǐ dāng lǎobǎn de zhùlǐ.
examples.english: Miss Chen's work ability is very strong; no wonder she can be the boss's assistant.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"老闆很滿意小陳的工作表現， 明年要請他當經理呢！","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"這次的比賽很重要，大家一定要好好地表現。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn hěn mǎnyì Xiǎo Chén de gōngzuò biǎoxiàn, míngnián yào qǐng tā dāng jīnglǐ ne! Zhè cì de bǐsài hěn zhòngyào, dàjiā yídìng yào hǎohǎo de biǎoxiàn.
examples.english: The boss is very satisfied with Xiao Chen's work performance and wants to ask him to be the manager next year! This competition is very important; everyone must perform well.

examples.chinese: 小黃要去便利商店領錢， 我請他幫我買杯咖啡。老闆去歐洲旅遊回來，買了荷蘭傳統的點心送給大家，叫我們去助理那裡領。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Huáng yào qù biànlì shāngdiàn lǐng qián, wǒ qǐng tā bāng wǒ mǎi bēi kāfēi. Lǎobǎn qù Ōuzhōu lǚyóu huílái, mǎile Hélán chuántǒng de diǎnxin sòng gěi dàjiā, jiào wǒmen qù zhùlǐ nàlǐ lǐng.
examples.english: Xiao Huang is going to the convenience store to withdraw money; I asked him to buy me a cup of coffee. The boss came back from a trip to Europe and bought traditional Dutch snacks to give to everyone, and told us to pick them up from the assistant.

examples.chinese: 錢老闆滿腦子都是工作，每天只想著怎麼讓公司成長得快一點。
examples.pinyin: Qián lǎobǎn mǎn nǎozi dōu shì gōngzuò, měitiān zhǐ xiǎngzhe zěnme ràng gōngsī chéngzhǎng de kuài yīdiǎn.
examples.english: Boss Qian's mind is full of work; every day he only thinks about how to make the company grow a bit faster.

examples.chinese: 這裡的每一樣產品都是老闆自己設計的，別的地方找不到相同的。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de měi yí yàng chǎnpǐn dōu shì lǎobǎn zìjǐ shèjì de, bié de dìfang zhǎo bú dào xiāngtóng de.
examples.english: Every kind of product here is designed by the owner himself; you can't find the same ones elsewhere.

examples.chinese: 李老闆是個很實在的人，他賣的包子不但好吃，餡料（xiànliào， filling）也很實在，難怪生意好得不得了。今天天氣實在太熱了，雖然夏天的電費很貴，我還是把冷氣打開了。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ lǎobǎn shì ge hěn shízài de rén, tā mài de bāozi búdàn hǎochī, xiànliào yě hěn shízài, nánguài shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo. Jīntiān tiānqì shízài tài rè le, suīrán xiàtiān de diànfèi hěn guì, wǒ háishì bǎ lěngqì dǎkāi le.
examples.english: Boss Li is a very honest person; the steamed buns he sells are not only delicious, but the filling is also very generous—no wonder his business is incredibly good. Today the weather is really too hot; although summer electricity bills are expensive, I still turned on the air conditioner.

examples.chinese: 我舅舅在公司的表現樣樣都好，所以老闆打算明年讓他當經理。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiùjiu zài gōngsī de biǎoxiàn yàngyàng dōu hǎo, suǒyǐ lǎobǎn dǎsuàn míngnián ràng tā dāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: My uncle's performance at the company is good in every aspect, so the boss plans to make him manager next year.

examples.chinese: 王老闆舉辦了一個免費吃鬆餅的活動，目的是調查哪種口味的鬆餅最受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎobǎn jǔbàn le yīgè miǎnfèi chī sōngbǐng de huódòng, mùdì shì diàochá nǎ zhǒng kǒuwèi de sōngbǐng zuì shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Boss Wang held an event with free waffles; the purpose was to investigate which flavor of waffle is most popular.

examples.chinese: 在這家餐廳吃飯，要是滿兩千元，老闆就免費招待一盤炒青菜。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng chīfàn, yàoshi mǎn liǎngqiān yuán, lǎobǎn jiù miǎnfèi zhāodài yī pán chǎo qīngcài.
examples.english: If you spend at least two thousand dollars at this restaurant, the owner will treat you to a free plate of stir-fried greens.

examples.chinese: 氣象預報人員確定明天颱風會來，我們最好去吃超市買一些泡麵、雞蛋。老闆要我照確定的日期去南部出差，如果有什麼改變，他會早點兒通知我。
examples.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào rényuán quèdìng míngtiān táifēng huì lái, wǒmen zuìhǎo qù chāoshì mǎi yìxiē pàomiàn, jīdàn. Lǎobǎn yào wǒ zhào quèdìng de rìqī qù nánbù chūchāi, rúguǒ yǒu shénme gǎibiàn, tā huì zǎodiǎnr tōngzhī wǒ.
examples.english: The weather forecasters are sure that the typhoon will come tomorrow; we'd better go to the supermarket to buy some instant noodles and eggs. The boss wants me to go on a business trip to the south according to the confirmed date; if there are any changes, he will notify me earlier.

examples.chinese: 這次的露營活動因為颱風辦不成了，可以說計畫永遠沒辦法趕上變化。張老闆開會開得太久，沒趕上飛機，只好花錢再買一張機票了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de lùyíng huódòng yīnwèi táifēng bàn bù chéng le, kěyǐ shuō jìhuà yǒngyuǎn méi bànfǎ gǎnshàng biànhuà. Zhāng lǎobǎn kāihuì kāi de tài jiǔ, méi gǎnshàng fēijī, zhǐhǎo huā qián zài mǎi yī zhāng jīpiào le.
examples.english: This camping activity couldn't be held because of the typhoon; you could say that plans can never catch up with changes. Boss Zhang's meeting went on too long, and he didn't catch the plane, so he had no choice but to spend money to buy another ticket.

examples.chinese: 老闆收到一封寫滿越南文的信，辦公室沒人看得懂，非找人翻譯不可。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn shōudào yī fēng xiě mǎn Yuènánwén de xìn, bàngōngshì méi rén kàn de dǒng, fēi zhǎo rén fānyì bùkě.
examples.english: The boss received a letter written entirely in Vietnamese; no one in the office could understand it, so he absolutely must find someone to translate it.

examples.chinese: 小戴才三十歲就已經是名牌服裝公司的大老闆，這麼年輕就有這樣的成就，實在不簡單。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Dài cái sānshí suì jiù yǐjīng shì míngpái fúzhuāng gōngsī de dà lǎobǎn, zhème niánqīng jiù yǒu zhèyàng de chéngjiù, shízài bù jiǎndān.
examples.english: Little Dai is only thirty years old and is already the big boss of a famous brand clothing company; to have such accomplishments at such a young age is really not simple.

examples.chinese: 黃先生上班常遲到，也不認真工作，這樣的態度讓老闆很不滿。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng shàngbān cháng chídào, yě bù rènzhēn gōngzuò, zhèyàng de tàidù ràng lǎobǎn hěn bùmǎn.
examples.english: Mr. Huang is often late for work and does not work seriously; this kind of attitude makes the boss very dissatisfied.

examples.chinese: 擔任這家公司的主管真不容易，不僅要管理整個部門的員工，還要達成老闆的工作要求。
examples.pinyin: Dānrèn zhè jiā gōngsī de zhǔguǎn zhēn bù róngyì, bùjǐn yào guǎnlǐ zhěnggè bùmén de yuángōng, hái yào dáchéng lǎobǎn de gōngzuò yāoqiú.
examples.english: Serving as a supervisor at this company is really not easy; not only do you have to manage the employees of the entire department, you also have to fulfill the boss's work requirements.

examples.chinese: 開會時如果老闆突然變得很安靜，也不表達任何意見時，就表示他生氣了。
examples.pinyin: Kāihuì shí rúguǒ lǎobǎn tūrán biàn de hěn ānjìng, yě bù biǎodá rènhé yìjiàn shí, jiù biǎoshì tā shēngqì le.
examples.english: If during a meeting the boss suddenly becomes very quiet and doesn't express any opinion, it shows that he is angry.

examples.chinese: 小連跟老闆吵架而離開了公司，為了讓家人能繼續過安定的生活，他正努力地找新工作。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lián gēn lǎobǎn chǎojià ér líkāi le gōngsī, wèile ràng jiārén néng jìxù guò āndìng de shēnghuó, tā zhèng nǔlì de zhǎo xīn gōngzuò.
examples.english: Xiao Lian left the company after quarreling with the boss; in order to let his family continue to live a safe and stable life, he is working hard to find a new job.

examples.chinese: 王老闆老是要求員工隨時配合他開會、加班、出差，真教人受不了。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎobǎn lǎoshì yāoqiú yuángōng suíshí pèihé tā kāihuì, jiābān, chūchāi, zhēn jiào rén shòu bù liǎo.
examples.english: Boss Wang is always requiring his employees to cooperate with him at any time for meetings, overtime, and business trips; it really makes people unable to stand it.

examples.chinese: 有個騙子吃完了麵，假裝忘記帶錢包，騙老闆要回家拿錢，一離開就沒回來了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu ge piànzi chī wán le miàn, jiǎzhuāng wàngjì dài qiánbāo, piàn lǎobǎn yào huí jiā ná qián, yī líkāi jiù méi huílái le.
examples.english: A cheater finished eating noodles and pretended to have forgotten his wallet; he tricked the owner into letting him go home to get money, and as soon as he left, he never came back.

examples.chinese: 那個老闆做生意不老實，一再跟客人保證商品沒問題，其實是騙人的。
examples.pinyin: Nàge lǎobǎn zuò shēngyì bù lǎoshí, yīzài gēn kèrén bǎozhèng shāngpǐn méi wèntí, qíshí shì piànrén de.
examples.english: That boss is not honest in doing business; he repeatedly assures customers that the products have no problems, but actually it's a scam.

examples.chinese: 今天開會時，經理表面上對老闆很客氣，其實心裡很不高興。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ biǎomiàn shàng duì lǎobǎn hěn kèqi, qíshí xīnlǐ hěn bù gāoxìng.
examples.english: During the meeting today, the manager was superficially very polite to the boss, but actually he was very unhappy inside.

examples.chinese: 何老闆替公司建立了良好的制度，讓員工都能安心地工作。
examples.pinyin: Hé lǎobǎn tì gōngsī jiànlì le liánghǎo de zhìdù, ràng yuángōng dōu néng ānxīn de gōngzuò.
examples.english: Boss He established a good system for the company, allowing employees to work with peace of mind.

examples.chinese: 簡老闆因為生意的關係，經常接觸越南人，相當了解兩國之間工作習慣的差異。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎn lǎobǎn yīnwèi shēngyì de guānxì, jīngcháng jiēchù Yuènánrén, xiāngdāng liǎojiě liǎng guó zhījiān gōngzuò xíguàn de chāyì.
examples.english: Boss Jian, because of business, frequently contacts Vietnamese people and quite understands the differences in working habits between the two countries.

examples.chinese: 學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí. Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria. Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: 這家公司福利不錯，每年除了提供免費健檢，老闆還會帶員工出國旅遊。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī fúlì búcuò, měinián chúle tígōng miǎnfèi jiànjiǎn, lǎobǎn hái huì dài yuángōng chūguó lǚyóu.
examples.english: This company's benefits are quite good; every year, in addition to providing free health checkups, the boss also takes the employees on overseas trips.

examples.chinese: 我打工的餐廳一到週末就客滿，忙不過來的時候，連老闆的叔叔都得來幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎgōng de cāntīng yí dào zhōumò jiù kèmǎn, máng bú guòlái de shíhou, lián lǎobǎn de shūshu dōu děi lái bāngmáng.
examples.english: The restaurant where I work part-time is full every weekend; when they are too busy to manage, even the boss's uncle has to come help.

examples.chinese: 你聽了尤老闆勇敢克服困難、堅持到底的真實故事，有什麼感想？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ tīng le Yóu lǎobǎn yǒnggǎn kèfú kùnnan, jiānchí dàodǐ de zhēnshí gùshi, yǒu shénme gǎnxiǎng?
examples.english: After hearing Boss You's true story of bravely overcoming difficulties and persevering to the end, what are your thoughts?

examples.chinese: 杜先生是三家網路商店的主管，他希望將來能當大企業的老闆，擁有自己的事業。
examples.pinyin: Dù xiānsheng shì sān jiā wǎnglù shāngdiàn de zhǔguǎn, tā xīwàng jiānglái néng dāng dà qǐyè de lǎobǎn, yǒngyǒu zìjǐ de shìyè.
examples.english: Mr. Du is the manager of three online stores; he hopes that in the future he can become the boss of a big enterprise and have his own career.

examples.chinese: 以電腦系統取代傳統收停車費的方式，能幫老闆節省工作人員的費用。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ diànnǎo xìtǒng qǔdài chuántǒng shōu tíngchē fèi de fāngshì, néng bāng lǎobǎn jiéshěng gōngzuò rényuán de fèiyòng.
examples.english: Replacing the traditional method of collecting parking fees with a computer system can help the boss save on staff costs.

examples.chinese: 面試時必須穿正式的服裝，跟老闆對話時，也應表現出客氣、 謙虛的態度。
examples.pinyin: Miànshì shí bìxū chuān zhèngshì de fúzhuāng, gēn lǎobǎn duìhuà shí, yě yīng biǎoxiàn chū kèqì, qiānxū de tàidù.
examples.english: During an interview, you must wear formal clothing; when speaking with the boss, you should also show a polite and modest attitude.

examples.chinese: 老闆為了感謝員工為公司付出這麼多，決定親手做菜請大家吃。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn wèile gǎnxiè yuángōng wèi gōngsī fùchū zhème duō, juédìng qīnshǒu zuò cài qǐng dàjiā chī.
examples.english: To thank the employees for contributing so much to the company, the boss decided to personally cook a meal and invite everyone to eat.

examples.chinese: 站在老闆背後的那個人已經通過了面試，明天就要來上班了。「每個成功男人的背後，都有一個偉大的女人。」你覺得這句話有道理嗎？
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhàn zài lǎobǎn bèihòu de nàge rén yǐjīng tōngguò le miànshì, míngtiān jiù yào lái shàngbān le. 2. Měi ge chénggōng nánrén de bèihòu, dōu yǒu yí ge wěidà de nǚrén. Nǐ juéde zhè jù huà yǒu dàolǐ ma?
examples.english: 1. The person standing behind the boss has already passed the interview and will come to work tomorrow. 2. Behind every successful man, there is a great woman. Do you think this saying makes sense?

examples.chinese: 這支手錶是我過世的爺爺留給我的，對我來說具有特別的意義。我的老闆具有獨特的領導魅力， 員工都願意跟著他努力工作。
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhè zhī shǒubiǎo shì wǒ guòshì de yéye liú gěi wǒ de, duì wǒ lái shuō jùyǒu tèbié de yìyì. 2. Wǒ de lǎobǎn jùyǒu dútè de lǐngdǎo mèilì, yuángōng dōu yuànyì gēnzhe tā nǔlì gōngzuò.
examples.english: 1. This watch was left to me by my late grandfather; to me, it has special significance. 2. My boss has a unique leadership charisma; the employees are all willing to work hard following him.

examples.chinese: A:你說老闆下個月要提高每個人的薪水，沒騙我吧？ B:這個消息是從他的口中說出來的，當然是真的。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ shuō lǎobǎn xià gè yuè yào tígāo měi gè rén de xīnshuǐ, méi piàn wǒ ba? B: Zhège xiāoxi shì cóng tā de kǒu zhōng shuō chūlái de, dāngrán shì zhēn de.
examples.english: A: You said the boss is going to raise everyone's salary next month—you're not fooling me, are you? B: This news came out of his own mouth; of course it's true.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese: 連警察都證明這個車禍是段老闆喝醉造成的，可是他仍然不肯承認。
examples.pinyin: Lián jǐngchá dōu zhèngmíng zhège chēhuò shì Duàn lǎobǎn hē zuì zàochéng de, kěshì tā réngrán bù kěn chéngrèn.
examples.english: Even the police proved that this car accident was caused by Boss Duan getting drunk, but he still refuses to admit it.

examples.chinese: 為了愛惜食物資源，同時也幫助生活困難的家庭，張老闆決定在國內開幾家食物銀行。
examples.pinyin: Wèile àixī shíwù zīyuán, tóngshí yě bāngzhù shēnghuó kùnnán de jiātíng, Zhāng lǎobǎn juédìng zài guónèi kāi jǐ jiā shíwù yínháng.
examples.english: In order to cherish food resources and at the same time help families with financial difficulties, Boss Zhang decided to open several food banks in the country.

examples.chinese: 自己開店做老闆，事事都得自己來，其實不太容易。
examples.pinyin: Zìjǐ kāidiàn zuò lǎobǎn, shìshì dōu děi zìjǐ lái, qíshí bù tài róngyì.
examples.english: Opening your own shop and being the boss means you have to do everything yourself; actually, it's not that easy.

examples.chinese: 老闆說，除了緊急情況，下班時間別打電話找他。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn shuō, chúle jǐnjí qíngkuàng, xiàbān shíjiān bié dǎ diànhuà zhǎo tā.
examples.english: The boss said that except for urgent situations, don't call him after work hours.

examples.chinese: 他曾替公司談成了三億美元的生意，因此老闆讓他當經理。
examples.pinyin: Tā céng tì gōngsī tán chéng le sān yì měiyuán de shēngyì, yīncǐ lǎobǎn ràng tā dāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: He once negotiated a three-hundred-million-dollar deal for the company, so the boss made him manager.

examples.chinese: 他個性獨立，加上做事總是很細心，因此老闆很欣賞他。
examples.pinyin: Tā gèxìng dúlì, jiāshàng zuòshì zǒngshì hěn xìxīn, yīncǐ lǎobǎn hěn xīnshǎng tā.
examples.english: He has an independent personality; on top of that, he is always very careful in doing things, so the boss appreciates him very much.

examples.chinese: 那件名牌長裙才兩千元而已，用不著跟老闆殺價。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiàn míngpái chángqún cái liǎngqiān yuán éryǐ, yòngbuzháo gēn lǎobǎn shājià.
examples.english: That brand-name long skirt is only two thousand yuan, that's all; there's no need to haggle with the shopkeeper.

examples.chinese: 開早餐店很辛苦，大清早老闆就得起來準備。
examples.pinyin: Kāi zǎocāndiàn hěn xīnkǔ, dàqīngzǎo lǎobǎn jiù děi qǐlái zhǔnbèi.
examples.english: Running a breakfast shop is very hard; early in the morning, the owner has to get up to prepare.

examples.chinese: 那位客人在地攤買東西揀來揀去，最後又不買，難怪老闆滿臉不高興的樣子。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi kèrén zài dìtān mǎi dōngxi jiǎn lái jiǎn qù, zuìhòu yòu bù mǎi, nánguài lǎobǎn mǎn liǎn bù gāoxìng de yàngzi.
examples.english: That customer kept picking and choosing while shopping at the street stall, and in the end didn’t buy anything; no wonder the owner looked unhappy.

examples.chinese: 工會代表跟老闆討論工資問題，認為公司給的工錢仍然太低。
examples.pinyin: Gōnghuì dàibiǎo gēn lǎobǎn tǎolùn gōngzī wèntí, rènwéi gōngsī gěi de gōngqián réngrán tài dī.
examples.english: The union representative discussed the wage issue with the boss, believing that the wages the company offers are still too low.

examples.chinese: 別看張老闆平日吃的、用的都很省，其實他是某家大型電子企業的老闆。
examples.pinyin: Bié kàn Zhāng lǎobǎn píngrì chī de, yòng de dōu hěn shěng, qíshí tā shì mǒu jiā dàxíng diànzǐ qǐyè de lǎobǎn.
examples.english: Don't be fooled by how economical Boss Zhang is in what he eats and uses every day—he's actually the boss of a large electronics company.

examples.chinese: 祕書趁老闆不在把商品計畫偷走，這事已經交給法院處理了。
examples.pinyin: Mìshū chèn lǎobǎn bú zài bǎ shāngpǐn jìhuà tōu zǒu, zhè shì yǐjīng jiāo gěi fǎyuàn chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: The secretary took advantage of the boss's absence to steal the product plan; this matter has already been handed over to the court.

examples.chinese: 公司來了位新同事，老闆要我向他一一介紹公司的規定。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī lái le wèi xīn tóngshì, lǎobǎn yào wǒ xiàng tā yīyī jièshào gōngsī de guīdìng.
examples.english: A new colleague came to the company, and the boss asked me to introduce the company's rules to him one by one.

examples.chinese: 你聽，這是什聲音？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ tīng, zhè shì shénme shēngyīn?
examples.english: Listen, what sound is this?

examples.chinese: 弟弟半夜在房間聽音樂，聲音很吵。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi bànyè zài fángjiān tīng yīnyuè, shēngyīn hěn chǎo.
examples.english: My little brother listens to music in his room in the middle of the night, and the sound is very noisy.

examples.chinese: 外面的風很大，聲音聽起來很可怕。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn de fēng hěn dà, shēngyīn tīng qǐlái hěn kěpà.
examples.english: The wind outside is very strong; the sound sounds very scary.

examples.chinese: 我聽見樓下有奇怪的聲音，是不是有小偷啊？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tīngjiàn lóuxià yǒu qíguài de shēngyīn, shìbushì yǒu xiǎotōu a?
examples.english: I hear a strange sound downstairs—is there a thief?

examples.english: 1. The sound of firecrackers is very scary; it scared the child to tears. 2. When the midnight bell rings at twelve o'clock, we will set off firecrackers to celebrate the New Year.

examples.chinese: 當軍隊一到達災區，就聽到了求救的聲音，所以立刻開始救災工作。
examples.pinyin: Dāng jūnduì yí dàodá zāiqū, jiù tīngdào le qiújiù de shēngyīn, suǒyǐ lìkè kāishǐ jiùzāi gōngzuò.
examples.english: As soon as the military arrived at the disaster area, they heard calls for help, so they immediately began disaster relief work.

examples.chinese: 我在山上工作，手機的訊號很弱，朋友常抱怨我的電話不是打不通，就是聲音不清楚。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài shānshàng gōngzuò, shǒujī de xìnhào hěn ruò, péngyǒu cháng bàoyuàn wǒ de diànhuà bú shì dǎ bù tōng, jiù shì shēngyīn bù qīngchu.
examples.english: I work in the mountains, and the cell phone signal is very weak. My friends often complain that my phone either can't be reached or the voice is unclear.

examples.chinese: 公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng. Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english: The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it. Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: 那家店的門是自動的，只要站到門前就會自動打開。這棟大樓有安全系統的設備，小偷進去就會自動發出警告的聲音通知警察。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de mén shì zìdòng de, zhǐyào zhàn dào mén qián jiù huì zìdòng dǎkāi. Zhè dòng dàlóu yǒu ānquán xìtǒng de shèbèi, xiǎotōu jìnqù jiù huì zìdòng fāchū jǐnggào de shēngyīn tōngzhī jǐngchá.
examples.english: The door of that shop is automatic; as soon as you stand in front of the door, it will open automatically. This building has safety system equipment; if a thief enters, it will automatically emit a warning sound to notify the police.

examples.chinese: 昨晚我接了好幾通沒有聲音的電話，真的很討厭。
examples.pinyin: Zuówǎn wǒ jiē le hǎo jǐ tōng méiyǒu shēngyīn de diànhuà, zhēn de hěn tǎoyàn.
examples.english: Last night I received several silent phone calls; it was really annoying.

examples.chinese: 當周圍環境很靜的時候，可以聽見平常聽不到的聲音。
examples.pinyin: Dāng zhōuwéi huánjìng hěn jìng de shíhou, kěyǐ tīngjiàn píngcháng tīng bù dào de shēngyīn.
examples.english: When the surrounding environment is very quiet, you can hear sounds that you normally cannot hear.

examples.chinese: 伯父的孩子是對雙胞胎，不只是樣子，連說話的聲音都像。
examples.pinyin: Bófù de háizi shì duì shuāngbāotāi, bù zhǐshì yàngzi, lián shuōhuà de shēngyīn dōu xiàng.
examples.english: My uncle's children are a pair of twins; not only do they look alike, even their speaking voices are similar.

examples.chinese: 這位郵差的聲音很大，每次他來送信，整條街全都聽見了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yóuchāi de shēngyīn hěn dà, měi cì tā lái sòng xìn, zhěng tiáo jiē quán dōu tīngjiàn le.
examples.english: This postman's voice is very loud; every time he comes to deliver mail, the whole street hears it.

examples.chinese: 我跟室友的個性、興趣都差不多，所以我們是好朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn shìyǒu de gèxìng, xìngqù dōu chàbuduō, suǒyǐ wǒmen shì hǎo péngyou.
examples.english: My roommate and I are similar in personality and interests, so we are good friends.

examples.chinese: 張小姐的個性活潑大方，難怪有很多朋友。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiǎojiě de gèxìng huópō dàfāng, nánguài yǒu hěn duō péngyou.
examples.english: Miss Zhang's personality is lively and generous; no wonder she has many friends.

examples.chinese: 尚恩是家豪的好朋友，非常清楚他的個性，連他喜歡吃什麼都很清楚。
examples.pinyin: Shàng'ēn shì Jiāháo de hǎo péngyou, fēicháng qīngchǔ tā de gèxìng, lián tā xǐhuān chī shénme dōu hěn qīngchǔ.
examples.english: Shawn is Jiahao's good friend and is very clear about his personality; he is even very clear about what he likes to eat.

examples.chinese: 何小姐地個性溫柔，笑起來也很迷人，所以追求她的人很多。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě de gèxìng wēnróu, xiào qǐlái yě hěn mírén, suǒyǐ zhuīqiú tā de rén hěn duō.
examples.english: Miss He has a gentle personality and her smile is very charming, so many people pursue her.

examples.chinese: 張先生的個性很活潑、說話很幽默，跟他聊天總是很愉快。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng de gèxìng hěn huópō, shuōhuà hěn yōumò, gēn tā liáotiān zǒngshì hěn yúkuài.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang's personality is very lively and his speech is very humorous; chatting with him is always very pleasant.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹的個性太單純了，別人說什麼她都相信，難怪常吃虧。經理找你談話，只是單純地想了解你對新工作適不適應，你別緊張。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei de gèxìng tài dānchún le, biérén shuō shénme tā dōu xiāngxìn, nánguài cháng chīkuī. Jīnglǐ zhǎo nǐ tánhuà, zhǐshì dānchún de xiǎng liǎojiě nǐ duì xīn gōngzuò shì bù shì yìng, nǐ bié jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: My younger sister's personality is too pure; she believes whatever others say, no wonder she often gets taken advantage of. The manager wants to talk with you simply to understand whether you are adapting to the new job; don't be nervous.

examples.chinese: 大雄從小個性就很被動，別人要求的事他才做，父母跟老師都希望他可以主動一點。
examples.pinyin: Dàxióng cóngxiǎo gèxìng jiù hěn bèidòng, biérén yāoqiú de shì tā cái zuò, fùmǔ gēn lǎoshī dōu xīwàng tā kěyǐ zhǔdòng yīdiǎn.
examples.english: Daxiong has been passive in personality since childhood; he only does things when others ask him to. His parents and teachers all hope he can be a bit more proactive.

examples.chinese: 佳佳認為談戀愛的對象，年齡不重要，容不容易溝通、個性適不適合才是最重要的。
examples.pinyin: Jiājiā rènwéi tán liàn'ài de duìxiàng, niánlíng bù zhòngyào, róng bù róngyì gōutōng, gèxìng shì bù shìhé cái shì zuì zhòngyào de.
examples.english: Jiajia believes that for a romantic partner, age is not important; whether it is easy to communicate with them and whether their personality suits you are the most important things.

examples.chinese: 那對雙胞胎長得很像，個性卻很不同，哥哥很大方，弟弟很害羞。
examples.pinyin: Nà duì shuāngbāotāi zhǎng de hěn xiàng, gèxìng què hěn bùtóng, gēge hěn dàfāng, dìdi hěn hàixiū.
examples.english: That pair of twins look very much alike, but their personalities are very different: the older brother is very outgoing, and the younger brother is very shy.

examples.chinese: 大多數的人認為哲學是一門很難的學問，不容易理解。先生的個性很奇怪，又愛亂發脾氣，除了他老婆，沒人能理解他。
examples.pinyin: Dàduōshù de rén rènwéi zhéxué shì yì mén hěn nán de xuéwèn, bù róngyì lǐjiě. Xiānsheng de gèxìng hěn qíguài, yòu ài luàn fā píqì, chúle tā lǎopó, méi rén néng lǐjiě tā.
examples.english: Most people think philosophy is a very difficult subject to understand. The husband's personality is very strange, and he also loves to lose his temper randomly; except for his wife, no one can understand him.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese: 老是忘記東西不見得是因為個性迷糊，也可能與健康有關。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshì wàngjì dōngxi bù jiànde shì yīnwèi gèxìng míhú, yě kěnéng yǔ jiànkāng yǒuguān.
examples.english: Always forgetting things is not necessarily because of an absentminded personality; it may also be related to health.

examples.chinese: 小張的個性比較懶，很少主動幫同事的忙。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng de gèxìng bǐjiào lǎn, hěn shǎo zhǔdòng bāng tóngshì de máng.
examples.english: Little Zhang's personality is rather lazy; he rarely takes the initiative to help his colleagues.

examples.chinese: 他個性獨立，加上做事總是很細心，因此老闆很欣賞他。
examples.pinyin: Tā gèxìng dúlì, jiāshàng zuòshì zǒngshì hěn xìxīn, yīncǐ lǎobǎn hěn xīnshǎng tā.
examples.english: He has an independent personality; on top of that, he is always very careful in doing things, so the boss appreciates him very much.

examples.chinese: 我跟他的個性、想法都合得來，就是飲食習慣合不來。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tā de gèxìng, xiǎngfǎ dōu hé de lái, jiùshì yǐnshí xíguàn hé bù lái.
examples.english: He and I get along in personality and ideas, but it's just our eating habits that are incompatible.

examples.chinese: A:江先生對父母很孝順，個性又溫柔，將來一定是好先生。B:這還用說嗎？要是妳對他有意思，就得早點兒行動喔！
examples.pinyin: A: Jiāng xiānsheng duì fùmǔ hěn xiàoshùn, gèxìng yòu wēnróu, jiānglái yīdìng shì hǎo xiānsheng. B: Zhè hái yòng shuō ma? Yàoshi nǐ duì tā yǒu yìsi, jiù děi zǎo diǎnr xíngdòng o!
examples.english: A: Mr. Jiang is very filial to his parents and has a gentle personality; in the future he will definitely be a good husband. B: You're telling me! If you're interested in him, you'd better make a move early!

examples.chinese: 個性親切、大方，通常是從事服務業的最佳人才。
examples.pinyin: Gèxìng qīnqiè, dàfāng, tōngcháng shì cóngshì fúwùyè de zuìjiā réncái.
examples.english: People with a friendly and generous personality are usually the best talent for working in the service industry.

examples.chinese: 便利商店不遠，從我家過去只要五分鐘。
examples.pinyin: Biànlì shāngdiàn bù yuǎn, cóng wǒ jiā guòqù zhǐyào wǔ fēnzhōng.
examples.english: The convenience store is not far; going over from my home takes only five minutes.

examples.chinese: 他去了好幾家便利商店，可是都沒有他要買的東西。
examples.pinyin: Tā qù le hǎojǐ jiā biànlì shāngdiàn, kěshì dōu méiyǒu tā yào mǎi de dōngxī.
examples.english: He went to several convenience stores, but none of them had what he wanted to buy.

examples.chinese: 你經過便利商店的時候，可以幫我買一瓶水嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīngguò biànlì shāngdiàn de shíhou, kěyǐ bāng wǒ mǎi yì píng shuǐ ma?
examples.english: When you pass by the convenience store, can you buy a bottle of water for me?

examples.chinese: 我去便利商店買了三罐啤酒，五瓶果汁。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù biànlì shāngdiàn mǎi le sān guàn píjiǔ, wǔ píng guǒzhī.
examples.english: I went to the convenience store and bought three cans of beer and five bottles of juice.

examples.chinese: 我去便利商店買了三罐啤酒，五瓶果汁。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù biànlì shāngdiàn mǎi le sān guàn píjiǔ, wǔ píng guǒzhī.
examples.english: I went to the convenience store and bought three cans of beer and five bottles of juice.

examples.chinese: 我想要得到便利商店的貼紙，所以花了很多錢買東西。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng yào dédào biànlì shāngdiàn de tiēzhǐ, suǒyǐ huā le hěn duō qián mǎi dōngxi.
examples.english: I wanted to get the convenience store stickers, so I spent a lot of money buying things.

examples.chinese: 媽媽：鹽用完了，幫我去便利商店買一包吧！孩子：好，我立刻去！
examples.pinyin: Māma: Yán yòng wán le, bāng wǒ qù biànlì shāngdiàn mǎi yī bāo ba! Háizi: Hǎo, wǒ lìkè qù!
examples.english: Mom: The salt is used up; help me go to the convenience store to buy a pack! Child: Okay, I'll go right away!

examples.chinese: 便利商店的服務有賣票、收電話費和水電費等。
examples.pinyin: Biànlì shāngdiàn de fúwù yǒu mài piào, shōu diànhuàfèi hé shuǐdiànfèi děng.
examples.english: The services at the convenience store include selling tickets, collecting telephone bills, and water and electricity bills, etc.

examples.chinese: 小黃要去便利商店領錢， 我請他幫我買杯咖啡。老闆去歐洲旅遊回來，買了荷蘭傳統的點心送給大家，叫我們去助理那裡領。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Huáng yào qù biànlì shāngdiàn lǐng qián, wǒ qǐng tā bāng wǒ mǎi bēi kāfēi. Lǎobǎn qù Ōuzhōu lǚyóu huílái, mǎile Hélán chuántǒng de diǎnxin sòng gěi dàjiā, jiào wǒmen qù zhùlǐ nàlǐ lǐng.
examples.english: Xiao Huang is going to the convenience store to withdraw money; I asked him to buy me a cup of coffee. The boss came back from a trip to Europe and bought traditional Dutch snacks to give to everyone, and told us to pick them up from the assistant.

examples.chinese: 那兩家便利商店同樣提供客人休息的座位，但是第二家的空間比第一家大多了。林媽媽總是給她的雙胞胎女兒穿同樣顏色、同樣大小的衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nà liǎng jiā biànlì shāngdiàn tóngyàng tígōng kèrén xiūxi de zuòwèi, dànshì dì èr jiā de kōngjiān bǐ dì yī jiā dà duō le. Lín māma zǒngshì gěi tā de shuāngbāotāi nǚ'ér chuān tóngyàng yánsè, tóngyàng dàxiǎo de yīfu.
examples.english: Those two convenience stores similarly provide seats for customers to rest, but the second store's space is much larger than the first's. Mrs. Lin always dresses her twin daughters in clothes of the same color and the same size.

examples.chinese: 那家便利商店的地理位置非常好，停車也很方便，難怪生意那麼好。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā biànlì shāngdiàn de dìlǐ wèizhì fēicháng hǎo, tíngchē yě hěn fāngbiàn, nánguài shēngyì nàme hǎo.
examples.english: That convenience store's geographical location is excellent, and parking is also very convenient; no wonder business is so good.

examples.chinese: 因為水災的關係，許多學校沒辦法正常上課，甚至連便利商店都關了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi shuǐzāi de guānxi, xǔduō xuéxiào méi bànfǎ zhèngcháng shàngkè, shènzhì lián biànlì shāngdiàn dōu guān le.
examples.english: Because of the flood, many schools cannot have classes normally; even convenience stores have closed.

examples.chinese: 何小姐走路回家時發覺有人跟在她後面，嚇得她趕快跑進便利商店，不敢回家了。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě zǒulù huí jiā shí fājué yǒu rén gēn zài tā hòumiàn, xià de tā gǎnkuài pǎo jìn biànlì shāngdiàn, bù gǎn huí jiā le.
examples.english: When Miss He was walking home, she came to know that someone was following behind her, which scared her so much that she quickly ran into a convenience store and didn't dare go home.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，上網訂好火車票後，可選擇到車站或便利商店取票。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, shàngwǎng dìng hǎo huǒchē piào hòu, kě xuǎnzé dào chēzhàn huò biànlì shāngdiàn qǔ piào.
examples.english: In Taiwan, after booking train tickets online, you can choose to pick up the tickets at the station or at a convenience store.

examples.chinese: 這家便利商店現在有「咖啡、茶飲買一送一」的優惠活動。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā biànlì shāngdiàn xiànzài yǒu “kāfēi, cháyǐn mǎi yī sòng yī” de yōuhuì huódòng.
examples.english: This convenience store now has a “buy one get one free” promotion on coffee and tea drinks.

examples.chinese: 這個房子的房租不包括水費、電費。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fángzi de fángzū bù bāokuò shuǐfèi, diànfèi.
examples.english: The rent for this house does not include the water fee and electricity fee.

examples.chinese: 我的房租每個月一萬塊，加上水費、電費，差不多一萬三。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fángzū měi gè yuè yī wàn kuài, jiāshàng shuǐfèi, diànfèi, chàbuduō yī wàn sān.
examples.english: My rent is 10,000 dollars a month; plus water and electricity fees, it's about 13,000.

examples.chinese: 便利商店的服務有賣票、收電話費和水電費等。
examples.pinyin: Biànlì shāngdiàn de fúwù yǒu mài piào, shōu diànhuàfèi hé shuǐdiànfèi děng.
examples.english: The services at the convenience store include selling tickets, collecting telephone bills, and water and electricity bills, etc.

examples.chinese: 李老闆是個很實在的人，他賣的包子不但好吃，餡料（xiànliào， filling）也很實在，難怪生意好得不得了。今天天氣實在太熱了，雖然夏天的電費很貴，我還是把冷氣打開了。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ lǎobǎn shì ge hěn shízài de rén, tā mài de bāozi búdàn hǎochī, xiànliào yě hěn shízài, nánguài shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo. Jīntiān tiānqì shízài tài rè le, suīrán xiàtiān de diànfèi hěn guì, wǒ háishì bǎ lěngqì dǎkāi le.
examples.english: Boss Li is a very honest person; the steamed buns he sells are not only delicious, but the filling is also very generous—no wonder his business is incredibly good. Today the weather is really too hot; although summer electricity bills are expensive, I still turned on the air conditioner.

examples.chinese: 他這個月花了太多錢，因此連水電費、房租都繳不出來。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhège yuè huā le tài duō qián, yīncǐ lián shuǐdiànfèi, fángzū dōu jiǎo bù chūlái.
examples.english: He spent too much money this month, so he can't even pay his water and electricity bills and rent.

examples.chinese: 冷氣的溫度要是控制得剛好，不但對健康好，也能省點兒電費。
examples.pinyin: Lěngqì de wēndù yàoshi kòngzhì de gānghǎo, bùdàn duì jiànkāng hǎo, yě néng shěng diǎnr diànfèi.
examples.english: If the air conditioner's temperature is controlled to be just right, it is not only good for health but also saves a bit on electricity bills.

examples.chinese: 自從政府宣布石油、電費雙漲的作法以來，反對的民眾人數已近七成。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng zhèngfǔ xuānbù shíyóu, diànfèi shuāng zhǎng de zuòfǎ yǐlái, fǎnduì de mínzhòng rénshù yǐ jìn qī chéng.
examples.english: Since the government announced the policy of raising both oil and electricity prices, the number of people opposed has approached seventy percent.

examples.chinese: 我們在逛夜市的時候，忽然下雨了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài guàng yèshì de shíhòu, hūrán xià yǔ le.
examples.english: While we were strolling through the night market, it suddenly started to rain.

examples.chinese: 我們正在烤肉的時候，忽然下雨了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhèngzài kǎo ròu de shíhou, hūrán xià yǔ le.
examples.english: While we were having a barbecue, it suddenly started to rain.

examples.chinese: 我在森林裡散步的時候，忽然出現了一隻可愛的兔子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài sēnlín lǐ sànbù de shíhou, hūrán chūxiàn le yì zhī kě'ài de tùzi.
examples.english: While I was taking a walk in the forest, a cute rabbit suddenly appeared.

examples.chinese: 早上開車去上班時，忽然有隻狗從路口跑出來，把我嚇了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang kāichē qù shàngbān shí, hūrán yǒu zhī gǒu cóng lùkǒu pǎo chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yí tiào.
examples.english: When I was driving to work this morning, a dog suddenly ran out from the intersection and gave me a shock.

examples.chinese: 上週末我們去爬山，走到半路時忽然吹起大風來，害我們不得不下山。
examples.pinyin: Shàng zhōumò wǒmen qù páshān, zǒu dào bànlù shí hūrán chuī qǐ dàfēng lái, hài wǒmen bùdébù xiàshān.
examples.english: Last weekend we went mountain climbing, and when we had walked halfway, suddenly a strong wind started blowing, which forced us to have to go down the mountain.

examples.pinyin: Cānjiā shètuán huódòng, shì ràng zìjǐ chéngzhǎng de hǎo jīhuì. Háizi chūguó liúxué yǐhòu, fùmǔ fāxiàn háizi chéngzhǎng le bùshǎo.
examples.english: Participating in club activities is a good opportunity for personal growth. After their child went abroad to study, the parents found that the child had grown a lot.

examples.chinese: 我們的成長經驗、教育背景都差不多，所以想法也很像。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de chéngzhǎng jīngyàn, jiàoyù bèijǐng dōu chàbuduō, suǒyǐ xiǎngfǎ yě hěn xiàng.
examples.english: Our upbringing experiences and educational backgrounds are about the same, so our ideas are also very similar.

examples.chinese: 錢老闆滿腦子都是工作，每天只想著怎麼讓公司成長得快一點。
examples.pinyin: Qián lǎobǎn mǎn nǎozi dōu shì gōngzuò, měitiān zhǐ xiǎngzhe zěnme ràng gōngsī chéngzhǎng de kuài yīdiǎn.
examples.english: Boss Qian's mind is full of work; every day he only thinks about how to make the company grow a bit faster.

examples.chinese: 這家公司出版的小說，陪著不少讀者一塊兒成長，也帶給他們無窮的樂趣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī chūbǎn de xiǎoshuō, péi zhe bùshǎo dúzhě yíkuàir chéngzhǎng, yě dài gěi tāmen wúqióng de lèqù.
examples.english: The novels published by this company have accompanied many readers as they grew up, and have also brought them endless joy.

examples.chinese: 我想加入社會服務組織，幫助別人的同時也讓自己成長。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng jiārù shèhuì fúwù zǔzhī, bāngzhù biérén de tóngshí yě ràng zìjǐ chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: I want to join a social service organization; while helping others, I can also let myself grow.

examples.chinese: 政府最主要的任務應是維持並保護社會安全，其次是規畫各種制度，使國家穩定地成長。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zuì zhǔyào de rènwu yīng shì wéichí bìng bǎohù shèhuì ānquán, qícì shì guīhuà gè zhǒng zhìdù, shǐ guójiā wěndìng de chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: The government's most main task should be to maintain and protect social security; next is to plan various systems so that the country can grow stably.

examples.chinese: 都市人口如果過度成長，容易引發環保及交通問題。
examples.pinyin: Dūshì rénkǒu rúguǒ guòdù chéngzhǎng, róngyì yǐnfā huánbǎo jí jiāotōng wèntí.
examples.english: If urban population grows excessively, it easily leads to environmental and traffic problems.

examples.chinese: 人的性格主要是受成長環境的影響，跟性別沒有太大的關係。
examples.pinyin: Rén de xìnggé zhǔyào shì shòu chéngzhǎng huánjìng de yǐngxiǎng, gēn xìngbié méiyǒu tài dà de guānxi.
examples.english: A person's personality is mainly influenced by their growing environment, and has little to do with gender.

examples.chinese: 越南同學的表演太棒了，我們一直拍手叫好！
examples.pinyin: Yuènán tóngxué de biǎoyǎn tài bàng le, wǒmen yìzhí pāishǒu jiàohǎo!
examples.english: The Vietnamese classmate's performance was so great that we kept clapping and cheering!

examples.chinese: 小王手裡提著那麼多東西，好像很重，我們過去幫他提一些吧！
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng shǒu lǐ tízhe nàme duō dōngxi, hǎoxiàng hěn zhòng, wǒmen guòqù bāng tā tí yīxiē ba!
examples.english: Xiao Wang is carrying so many things in his hands; they look heavy. Let's go over and help him carry some!

examples.chinese: 那家廣告公司提供了五個工作機會，只要是設計系畢業的都可以去試試看。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā guǎnggào gōngsī tígōng le wǔ ge gōngzuò jīhuì, zhǐyào shì shèjì xì bìyè de dōu kěyǐ qù shìshi kàn.
examples.english: That advertising company provided five job opportunities; anyone who has graduated from a design department can go and give it a try.

examples.chinese: 今天開會時，經理提到公司打算做市場研究，希望大家下次能發表自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ tí dào gōngsī dǎsuàn zuò shìchǎng yánjiū, xīwàng dàjiā xiàcì néng fābiǎo zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: At today's meeting, the manager mentioned that the company plans to do market research, and hopes everyone can express their own ideas next time.

examples.chinese: 這所大學有最新的電腦設備，提供學生很好的學習環境。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué yǒu zuìxīn de diànnǎo shèbèi, tígōng xuéshēng hěn hǎo de xuéxí huánjìng.
examples.english: This university has the latest computer equipment, providing students with a very good learning environment.

examples.chinese: 那兩家便利商店同樣提供客人休息的座位，但是第二家的空間比第一家大多了。林媽媽總是給她的雙胞胎女兒穿同樣顏色、同樣大小的衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nà liǎng jiā biànlì shāngdiàn tóngyàng tígōng kèrén xiūxi de zuòwèi, dànshì dì èr jiā de kōngjiān bǐ dì yī jiā dà duō le. Lín māma zǒngshì gěi tā de shuāngbāotāi nǚ'ér chuān tóngyàng yánsè, tóngyàng dàxiǎo de yīfu.
examples.english: Those two convenience stores similarly provide seats for customers to rest, but the second store's space is much larger than the first's. Mrs. Lin always dresses her twin daughters in clothes of the same color and the same size.

examples.chinese: 我覺得住在鄉下除了購物不方便以外，什麼都好。我的房東只提供家具、電視和冰箱，以外的東西他不管。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhù zài xiāngxià chúle gòuwù bù fāngbiàn yǐwài, shénme dōu hǎo. Wǒ de fángdōng zhǐ tígōng jiājù, diànshì hé bīngxiāng, yǐwài de dōngxi tā bù guǎn.
examples.english: I think that living in the countryside, apart from shopping being inconvenient, everything is good. My landlord only provides furniture, a TV, and a refrigerator; he doesn't care about things beyond that.

examples.chinese: 為了提高英文程度，我除了認真上課、寫作業，還每天聽收音機的英文廣播。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù, wǒ chúle rènzhēn shàngkè, xiě zuòyè, hái měi tiān tīng shōuyīnjī de Yīngwén guǎngbō.
examples.english: In order to raise my English level, besides attending class seriously and doing homework, I also listen to English radio broadcasts every day.

examples.chinese: A: 現在的科技提供非常好用的網路服務，而且很多都是免費的。 B: 好用倒是好用，可是萬一沒有網路，就什麼都做不了了。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiànzài de kējì tígōng fēicháng hǎoyòng de wǎnglù fúwù, érqiě hěnduō dōu shì miǎnfèi de. B: Hǎoyòng dàoshì hǎoyòng, kěshì wànyī méiyǒu wǎnglù, jiù shénme dōu zuò bù liǎo le.
examples.english: A: Today's technology provides very easy-to-use internet services, and many are free. B: Sure, it's easy to use, but if there's no internet, then you can't do anything.

examples.chinese: 大寶明年有去英國留學的打算，所以找了家庭教師幫他補習， 希望提高英文程度。
examples.pinyin: Dàbǎo míngnián yǒu qù Yīngguó liúxué de dǎsuàn, suǒyǐ zhǎo le jiātíng jiàoshī bāng tā bǔxí, xīwàng tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù.
examples.english: Dabao plans to study abroad in the UK next year, so he found a private tutor to help him with cram tutoring, hoping to improve his English level.

examples.chinese: 發生大地震後，民眾都發揮愛心，主動提供救災的相關用品給災民。
examples.pinyin: Fāshēng dà dìzhèn hòu, mínzhòng dōu fāhuī àixīn, zhǔdòng tígōng jiùzāi de xiāngguān yòngpǐn gěi zāimín.
examples.english: After the major earthquake, people showed compassion and proactively provided disaster-relief related supplies to the victims.

examples.chinese: 當人們生活水準提高，開始重視生活品質時，休閒活動也就跟著多了起來。
examples.pinyin: Dāng rénmen shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn tígāo, kāishǐ zhòngshì shēnghuó pǐnzhí shí, xiūxián huódòng yě jiù gēnzhe duō le qǐlái.
examples.english: When people's standard of living rises and they begin to value quality of life, leisure activities then increase accordingly.

examples.chinese: 市長解決了不少這個城市的生活問題，因此民眾的生活水準也大大提高了。
examples.pinyin: Shìzhǎng jiějué le bùshǎo zhège chéngshì de shēnghuó wèntí, yīncǐ mínzhòng de shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn yě dàdà tígāo le.
examples.english: The mayor solved quite a few of this city's living problems, therefore the people's standard of living has also greatly improved.

examples.chinese: 這個國家公園的服務中心提供遊客簡介，介紹公園的特色和有名的景點。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā gōngyuán de fúwù zhōngxīn tígōng yóukè jiǎnjiè, jièshào gōngyuán de tèsè hé yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn.
examples.english: This national park's service center provides visitors with a brief introduction, introducing the park's features and famous scenic spots.

examples.chinese: 為了提供學生良好的學習環境，學校改善了教室的設備，網路的速度也變快了。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígōng xuéshēng liánghǎo de xuéxí huánjìng, xuéxiào gǎishàn le jiàoshì de shèbèi, wǎnglù de sùdù yě biàn kuài le.
examples.english: In order to provide students with a good learning environment, the school improved the classroom equipment, and the internet speed also became faster.

examples.chinese: 大學教育的目的，不僅要提高學生的知識水準，還要進一步培養學生的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué jiàoyù de mùdì, bùjǐn yào tígāo xuéshēng de zhīshì shuǐzhǔn, hái yào jìnyībù péiyǎng xuéshēng de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: The purpose of university education is not only to raise students' level of knowledge but also to further cultivate students' professional abilities.

examples.chinese: 出國留學有不少好處，例如打開視野、增加自信、提高外文程度等等。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó liúxué yǒu bùshǎo hǎochù, lìrú dǎkāi shìyě, zēngjiā zìxìn, tígāo wàiwén chéngdù děngděng.
examples.english: Studying abroad has many benefits, for example, broadening one's horizons, increasing self-confidence, improving foreign language proficiency, and so on.

examples.chinese: 假如貴公司想擴大生產規模，可以參考本公司的作法，我們很願意提供協助。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú guì gōngsī xiǎng kuòdà shēngchǎn guīmó, kěyǐ cānkǎo běn gōngsī de zuòfǎ, wǒmen hěn yuànyì tígōng xiézhù.
examples.english: If your honorable company wants to expand production scale, you can refer to our company's methods; we are very willing to provide assistance.

examples.chinese: 這家公司福利不錯，每年除了提供免費健檢，老闆還會帶員工出國旅遊。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī fúlì búcuò, měinián chúle tígōng miǎnfèi jiànjiǎn, lǎobǎn hái huì dài yuángōng chūguó lǚyóu.
examples.english: This company's benefits are quite good; every year, in addition to providing free health checkups, the boss also takes the employees on overseas trips.

examples.chinese: 現代企業越來越重視員工的福利和健康，例如提供免費的旅遊和健檢。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài qǐyè yuèláiyuè zhòngshì yuángōng de fúlì hé jiànkāng, lìrú tígōng miǎnfèi de lǚyóu hé jiànjiǎn.
examples.english: Modern enterprises increasingly value employee benefits and health, for example, providing free travel and health checkups.

examples.chinese: 為了提高英文的聽力水平，我除了聽收音機的英文廣播，也會看美國的電視新聞。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le tígāo Yīngwén de tīnglì shuǐpíng, wǒ chú le tīng shōuyīnjī de Yīngwén guǎngbō, yě huì kàn Měiguó de diànshì xīnwén.
examples.english: In order to improve my English listening level, besides listening to English radio broadcasts, I also watch American TV news.

examples.chinese: 時代進步了，女人在家庭和社會中的地位也跟著提高了。在古代中國，男人不應該進廚房的傳統觀念，也因為時代的改變而不同。
examples.pinyin: Shídài jìnbù le, nǚrén zài jiātíng hé shèhuì zhōng de dìwèi yě gēnzhe tígāo le. Zài gǔdài Zhōngguó, nánrén bù yīnggāi jìn chúfáng de chuántǒng guānniàn, yě yīnwèi shídài de gǎibiàn ér bùtóng.
examples.english: Times have progressed, and women's status in the family and society has risen accordingly. In ancient China, the traditional concept that men should not enter the kitchen has also changed with the times.

examples.chinese: A:公司從明天起就不再提供免費的三餐了。 B:這麼重大的決定，為什麼現在才通知我們？
examples.pinyin: A: Gōngsī cóng míngtiān qǐ jiù bù zài tígōng miǎnfèi de sān cān le. B: Zhème zhòngdà de juédìng, wèishénme xiànzài cái tōngzhī wǒmen?
examples.english: A: Starting tomorrow, the company will no longer provide free three meals. B: Such a major decision—why are we only being notified now?

examples.chinese: A:你說老闆下個月要提高每個人的薪水，沒騙我吧？ B:這個消息是從他的口中說出來的，當然是真的。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ shuō lǎobǎn xià gè yuè yào tígāo měi gè rén de xīnshuǐ, méi piàn wǒ ba? B: Zhège xiāoxi shì cóng tā de kǒu zhōng shuō chūlái de, dāngrán shì zhēn de.
examples.english: A: You said the boss is going to raise everyone's salary next month—you're not fooling me, are you? B: This news came out of his own mouth; of course it's true.

examples.chinese: 為了提高這座城市的文化水準，市長積極建設藝術表演中心、圖書館等公共空間。像機場、高鐵、捷運這類公共交通建設，都需要很多經費才能完成。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo zhè zuò chéngshì de wénhuà shuǐzhǔn, shìzhǎng jījí jiànshè yìshù biǎoyǎn zhōngxīn, túshūguǎn děng gōnggòng kōngjiān. Xiàng jīchǎng, gāotiě, jiéyùn zhè lèi gōnggòng jiāotōng jiànshè, dōu xūyào hěn duō jīngfèi cái néng wánchéng.
examples.english: In order to raise the cultural level of this city, the mayor actively builds public spaces such as art performance centers and libraries. Public transportation construction such as airports, high-speed rail, and MRT requires a lot of funds to complete.

examples.chinese: 從六○年代開始，臺灣就提供農業方面的協助給許多國家，這點讓我覺得很驕傲。
examples.pinyin: Cóng liù○ niándài kāishǐ, Táiwān jiù tígōng nóngyè fāngmiàn de xiézhù gěi xǔduō guójiā, zhè diǎn ràng wǒ juéde hěn jiāo'ào.
examples.english: Starting from the 1960s, Taiwan has provided assistance in agriculture to many countries; this point makes me feel very proud.

examples.chinese: 科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí. Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english: Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life. The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 快時尚的概念，就是在短時間內提供各式各樣的流行商品，讓顧客有更多更好的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Kuài shíshàng de gàiniàn, jiùshì zài duǎn shíjiān nèi tígōng gè shì gè yàng de liúxíng shāngpǐn, ràng gùkè yǒu gèng duō gèng hǎo de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The concept of fast fashion is to provide a variety of trendy products in a short time, giving customers more and better choices.

examples.chinese: 當鄰居生活遇到困難時，老馬總是主動提供協助，真令人感動。
examples.pinyin: Dāng línjū shēnghuó yùdào kùnnán shí, Lǎo Mǎ zǒngshì zhǔdòng tígōng xiézhù, zhēn lìng rén gǎndòng.
examples.english: When neighbors encounter difficulties in life, Old Ma always proactively offers assistance; it truly makes one moved.

examples.chinese: 我剛剛忘了把垃圾拿出去丟，還好你提醒我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng wàng le bǎ lèsè ná chūqù diū, háohǎo nǐ tíxǐng wǒ.
examples.english: I just forgot to take the garbage out to throw away—good thing you reminded me.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳的服務生很貼心，只要客人一上門，立刻提供面紙給客人擦手。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de fúwùshēng hěn tiēxīn, zhǐyào kèrén yī shàngmén, lìkè tígōng miànzhǐ gěi kèrén cā shǒu.
examples.english: The waiters at that restaurant are very considerate; as soon as customers come in, they immediately provide tissues for them to wipe their hands.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，碰到緊急情況可撥110，請警察提供協助。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, pèngdào jǐnjí qíngkuàng kě bō 110, qǐng jǐngchá tígōng xiézhù.
examples.english: In Taiwan, when encountering an emergency, you can dial 110 to ask the police for assistance.

examples.chinese: 那家超市蔬菜水果的種類很多，可提供民眾較多的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā chāoshì shūcài shuǐguǒ de zhǒnglèi hěn duō, kě tígōng mínzhòng jiào duō de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: That supermarket has many kinds of vegetables and fruits, which can provide people with more choices.

examples.chinese: 購物網站會把常見的購物問題及處理方式放在網頁上，提供給顧客參考。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù wǎngzhàn huì bǎ chángjiàn de gòuwù wèntí jí chǔlǐ fāngshì fàng zài wǎngyè shàng, tígōng gěi gùkè cānkǎo.
examples.english: Shopping websites will put commonly seen shopping problems and how to handle them on their web pages, providing them for customers' reference.

examples.chinese: 這家民宿提供西式、中式兩種早餐，既豐富又好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā mínsù tígōng xīshì, zhōngshì liǎng zhǒng zǎocān, jì fēngfù yòu hǎochī.
examples.english: This bed and breakfast offers both Western-style and Chinese-style breakfasts, which are both rich and delicious.

examples.chinese: 妹妹提了一個小桶水，很細心地幫爸爸擦櫃子。
examples.pinyin: Mèimei tí le yī gè xiǎo tǒng shuǐ, hěn xìxīn de bāng bàba cā guìzi.
examples.english: My younger sister carried a small bucket of water and carefully helped Dad wipe the cabinet.

examples.chinese: 那位博士在本次會議中所提到的問題，值得我們進一步研究。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi bóshì zài běn cì huìyì zhōng suǒ tí dào de wèntí, zhídé wǒmen jìnyībù yánjiū.
examples.english: The problems that that PhD mentioned in this conference are worth our further study.

examples.chinese: 醫生提醒我少吃油、鹽和糖，以減輕身體的負擔。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng wǒ shǎo chī yóu, yán hé táng, yǐ jiǎnqīng shēntǐ de fùdān.
examples.english: The doctor reminded me to eat less oil, salt, and sugar in order to lighten the body's burden.

examples.chinese: 今年下雪的時間提早了，氣候改變或許是最主要的原因。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián xià xuě de shíjiān tízǎo le, qìhòu gǎibiàn huòxǔ shì zuì zhǔyào de yuányīn.
examples.english: This year the time of snowfall came earlier than planned; climate change is perhaps the main reason.

examples.chinese: 練習八百公尺跑步時，教練除了要大家記得自己是跑第幾棒的，並且提醒我們把棒子拿好。
examples.pinyin: Liànxí bābǎi gōngchǐ pǎobù shí, jiàoliàn chúle yào dàjiā jìde zìjǐ shì pǎo dì jǐ bàng de, bìngqiě tíxǐng wǒmen bǎ bàngzi ná hǎo.
examples.english: When practicing the 800-meter run, the coach not only told everyone to remember which leg of the relay they were running, but also reminded us to hold the baton well.

examples.chinese: 如果想入會員並享受我們健身房所提供的服務，請您到櫃臺辦理。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng rù huìyuán bìng xiǎngshòu wǒmen jiànshēnfáng suǒ tígōng de fúwù, qǐng nín dào guìtái bànlǐ.
examples.english: If you want to become a member and enjoy the services provided by our gym, please go to the counter to handle it.

examples.chinese: 上次你跟我提的事，我一點兒印象都沒有，真是不好意思。
examples.pinyin: Shàng cì nǐ gēn wǒ tí de shì, wǒ yìdiǎnr yìnxiàng dōu méiyǒu, zhēn shì bù hǎoyìsi.
examples.english: The matter you mentioned to me last time—I don't have the slightest impression of it; I'm really sorry.

examples.chinese: 這次座談會邀請了各領域的人們，主要目的是對國內的地方建設提一些建議。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì zuòtánhuì yāoqǐng le gè lǐngyù de rénmen, zhǔyào mùdì shì duì guónèi de dìfāng jiànshè tí yìxiē jiànyì.
examples.english: This forum invited people from various fields; its main purpose is to offer some suggestions for domestic local construction.

examples.chinese: 根據手機公司的分析，明年大尺寸手機的市場需求會提高五倍以上。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù shǒujī gōngsī de fēnxī, míngnián dà chǐcùn shǒujī de shìchǎng xūqiú huì tígāo wǔ bèi yǐshàng.
examples.english: According to the cell phone company's analysis, next year the market demand for large-size cell phones will increase by more than five times.

examples.chinese: 那位教授提供病毒給軍隊使用，有些人認為他應該出來道歉。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi jiàoshòu tígōng bìngdú gěi jūnduì shǐyòng, yǒuxiē rén rènwéi tā yīnggāi chūlái dàoqiàn.
examples.english: That professor provided viruses for the military to use; some people think he should come out and apologize.

examples.chinese: 帶孩子到餐廳用餐，得提醒他們別到處奔跑，免得跌倒。
examples.pinyin: Dài háizi dào cāntīng yòngcān, děi tíxǐng tāmen bié dàochù bēnpǎo, miǎnde diēdǎo.
examples.english: When taking children to a restaurant to eat, you must remind them not to run around, so they don't fall.

examples.chinese: 對科學家或藝術家來說，提供他們一個不受限制的工作環境是很重要的。
examples.pinyin: Duì kēxuéjiā huò yìshùjiā lái shuō, tígōng tāmen yī gè bù shòu xiànzhì de gōngzuò huánjìng shì hěn zhòngyào de.
examples.english: For scientists or artists, providing them with a work environment that is not restricted is very important.

examples.chinese: 他在國外旅行時因為簽證有問題，回國時間只好提前了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài guówài lǚxíng shí yīnwèi qiānzhèng yǒu wèntí, huíguó shíjiān zhǐhǎo tíqián le.
examples.english: While traveling abroad, because there was a problem with his visa, his return date had to be moved up.

examples.chinese: 我習慣把每一筆支出都記錄起來，提醒自己少花點兒錢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xíguàn bǎ měi yì bǐ zhīchū dōu jìlù qǐlái, tíxǐng zìjǐ shǎo huā diǎnr qián.
examples.english: I am used to recording every expense, to remind myself to spend a little less money.

examples.chinese: 自從採用專家提供的方法後，茶葉的產量已增加百分之五十。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng cǎiyòng zhuānjiā tígōng de fāngfǎ hòu, cháyè de chǎnliàng yǐ zēngjiā bǎifēnzhī wǔshí.
examples.english: Since adopting the method provided by experts, the production output of tea leaves has increased by 50 percent.

examples.chinese: 老師提醒學生有疑問要馬上解決，免得越到後面越不了解。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī tíxǐng xuéshēng yǒu yíwèn yào mǎshàng jiějué, miǎnde yuè dào hòumiàn yuè bù liǎojiě.
examples.english: The teacher reminded the students that if they have any questions, they should resolve them immediately, lest the further they go, the less they understand.

examples.chinese: 學校餐廳提供各式各樣的營養食品，供學生挑選。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào cāntīng tígōng gè shì gè yàng de yíngyǎng shípǐn, gōng xuéshēng tiāoxuǎn.
examples.english: The school cafeteria provides a variety of nutritious foods for students to choose from.

examples.chinese: 政府建公立學校的目的，主要是提高人民接受教育的機會。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jiàn gōnglì xuéxiào de mùdì, zhǔyào shì tígāo rénmín jiēshòu jiàoyù de jīhuì.
examples.english: The government's purpose in building public schools is mainly to increase the people's opportunities to receive education.

examples.chinese: 孫小姐最近談成了幾筆大生意，表現出色，於是公司決定提高她的薪水。
examples.pinyin: Sūn xiǎojiě zuìjìn tán chéng le jǐ bǐ dà shēngyì, biǎoxiàn chūsè, yúshì gōngsī juédìng tígāo tā de xīnshuǐ.
examples.english: Miss Sun recently closed several big deals and her performance was outstanding, so the company decided to raise her salary.

examples.chinese: 做生意與其花大錢廣告，不如提高品質，讓顧客替你宣傳。
examples.pinyin: Zuò shēngyì yǔqí huā dà qián guǎnggào, bùrú tígāo pǐnzhí, ràng gùkè tì nǐ xuānchuán.
examples.english: In doing business, rather than spending a lot of money to advertise, it is better to improve quality and let customers promote you.

examples.chinese: 為了吸引人才，廣告企業提供獎金給優秀的設計師。
examples.pinyin: Wèile xīyǐn réncái, guǎnggào qǐyè tígōng jiǎngjīn gěi yōuxiù de shèjìshī.
examples.english: In order to attract talent, advertising companies offer bonuses to outstanding designers.

items.wordHook: A 扌(hand) lifts up what is 是(right) and proper, carrying it high into view: 提(carry).

examples.chinese: 「了」這個詞的用法可以代表事情完成或情況改變。
examples.pinyin: 「le」 zhège cí de yòngfǎ kěyǐ dàibiǎo shìqíng wánchéng huò qíngkuàng gǎibiàn.
examples.english: The usage of the word 'le' can represent the completion of an action or a change in situation.

examples.chinese: 剛學的詞和語法最好常使用、多複習，如此才能加深記憶。
examples.pinyin: Gāng xué de cí hé yǔfǎ zuì hǎo cháng shǐyòng, duō fùxí, rúcǐ cái néng jiāshēn jìyì.
examples.english: It's best to frequently use and review more the words and grammar you've just learned—only in this way can you deepen your memory.

examples.chinese: 台灣有句著名的廣告台詞「心動不如馬上行動」，意思是當個人有了想法之後，光是想是沒用的，得立刻行動才行。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yǒu jù zhùmíng de guǎnggào táicí “xīndòng bùrú mǎshàng xíngdòng”, yìsi shì dāng gèrén yǒu le xiǎngfǎ zhīhòu, guāng shì xiǎng shì méiyòng de, děi lìkè xíngdòng cái xíng.
examples.english: Taiwan has a famous advertising slogan, “Acting immediately is better than just being moved.” It means that after a person has an idea, merely thinking about it is useless; one must take action immediately.

examples.chinese: 噢，沒問題，你就放心交給我吧。
examples.pinyin: Ō, méi wèntí, nǐ jiù fàngxīn jiāo gěi wǒ ba.
examples.english: Oh, no problem, just hand it over to me with confidence.

examples.chinese: 這班飛機因為天氣不穩定，所以誤點了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì bù wěndìng, suǒyǐ wùdiǎn le.
examples.english: This flight was behind schedule because the weather was unstable.

examples.chinese: 在照顧及教育孩子上，父母都具有相同的法律義務。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhàogù jí jiàoyù háizi shàng, fùmǔ dōu jùyǒu xiāngtóng de fǎlǜ yìwù.
examples.english: In caring for and educating children, both parents have the same legal obligation.

examples.chinese: 從事電視新聞工作的人有義務傳播正確的消息。
examples.pinyin: Cóngshì diànshì xīnwén gōngzuò de rén yǒu yìwù chuánbō zhèngquè de xiāoxi.
examples.english: People working in television news have an obligation to disseminate correct information.

examples.chinese: 這兩臺機器樣子相同，但在構造與功能上是有差別的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tái jīqì yàngzi xiāngtóng, dàn zài gòuzào yǔ gōngnéng shàng shì yǒu chābié de.
examples.english: These two machines look the same, but they differ in structure and function.

examples.chinese: 今天的自然科學課程所介紹的主題是月球的構造。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de zìrán kēxué kèchéng suǒ jièshào de zhǔtí shì yuèqiú de gòuzào.
examples.english: The topic introduced in today's natural science course is the structure of the moon.

examples.chinese: 這臺食品加工設備的構造相當複雜，其中約三分之一的零件還是由國外進口。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái shípǐn jiāgōng shèbèi de gòuzào xiāngdāng fùzá, qízhōng yuē sān fēn zhī yī de língjiàn hái shì yóu guówài jìnkǒu.
examples.english: The structure of this food processing equipment is quite complex, and about one third of its parts are still imported from abroad.

examples.chinese: 我奶奶八十歲了，走起路來腳步仍像年輕人一樣。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai bāshí suì le, zǒu qǐ lù lái jiǎobù réng xiàng niánqīngrén yīyàng.
examples.english: My grandmother is eighty years old, but when she walks, her footsteps are still like those of a young person.

examples.chinese: 我們學校的啦啦隊隊員個子都很高，舞蹈的技巧也很出色。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào de lālāduì duìyuán gèzi dōu hěn gāo, wǔdǎo de jìqiǎo yě hěn chūsè.
examples.english: The cheerleading team members of our school are all very tall, and their dance skills are also excellent.

items.wordHook: a 木(tree) stands where paths 交(cross) → the yard of the 校(school).
Carving a 木(tree) block so precisely that flaws 莫(cannot) be found creates an ideal 模(model).
With 二(two) breaths and 欠(lack) of rest, she tries again → 次(time).
A 𠂉(lying person) counts 卌(forty) and 一(one) things, but the 灬(fire) burns them all: nothing left → 無(no).
a 竹(bamboo) slip rests at the 間(between) of two pages → plain and 簡(simple).
Combining 銀(silver) and 河(river): 銀河 means the Milky Way.
